handkerchief noun

classical

linteolum, linteolī n.

noun, second declension

small cloth

Other words

  • sūdārium, sūdāriī n.

    noun, second declension · classical · M-O s.v. handkerchief; Mart.; Petr.; Suet.; Traupman 325

  • * (our own formation) linteolum nāsō tergendō — cloth for wiping the nose

    also used · * our formation

    A descriptive phrase.

  • sūdāriolum, sūdāriolī n.

    noun, second declension · also used · post-classical · Apul.; Cordier, Coll. 2.69: Dēterge faciem sūdāriolō

Examples

  • Linteolum cape.

    Take the handkerchief.composed
